name: P49/P50 boundary, approval packet, source/license, target/rollback binding
question: Does the plan preserve P49/P50 source/license, approval, target and rollback boundaries while allowing safe independent tracks to continue when one track lacks approval?
finding_before: Approval packet was broad instead of track-separated.
The packet did not explicitly reject old quoted transcript or state approvals.
Source/license rules were not fully bound to the approval packet.
Target and rollback did not bind dataset sha, held-out sha, checkpoint shas, manifest, locator, fresh-load, continue-training, held-out, ablation and rollback probes in one place.
Missing approval for one track could accidentally become a global stop.
Final full-extension claim was not explicitly tied to packet-backed runtime/eval/training evidence.
recheck_evidence: Patched sections now separate approval tracks, reject reused approvals, bind source/license and target/rollback fields, add deferred_decision_queue, and prevent full-extension completion claims without packet-backed runtime/eval/training evidence.
